headline: Brazilian Real Rises Against US Dollar Amid US Midterms and Copom Expectations
summary: The US dollar closed down 0.65% against the Brazilian real at R$ 5.45, influenced by reactions to US midterm elections and expectations regarding the Copom meeting.
why: Currency exchange rates between the US dollar and emerging market currencies respond to shifts in global monetary policy expectations and geopolitical events.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Brazilian Real
impacts.why: Spot exchange rate reaction to domestic central bank expectations and global FX moves.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The dollar declined globally following US midterm election outcomes and as investors awaited domestic central bank (Copom) rate decisions.
